model_output.verdict: Your progression from Personal Banker to Branch Manager at Magnolia Community Bank is easy to follow, and the branch results back it up. I’d want to talk with you. My main question is what you’ve been doing since December 2024.
write_up: You’ve grown through three retail banking roles at Magnolia, most recently managing a branch. The team and deposit figures give a recruiter a good reason to keep reading for another branch manager role.

The deposit line is the strongest: it shows where deposits started, where they ended, and the period involved. The resume stops in December 2024, though, so a recruiter may pause over the time since before getting to that work.

Let’s account for the time after the branch role, then add what you personally handled in audits and escalated complaints. You don’t need to rewrite every line: the management and deposit figures already do useful work.
